title: Last-Minute Summer Escapes: TUI's Top Package Holiday Deals for 2024
text:
Discover TUI's curated selection of package holidays for last-minute summer getaways. From adults-only resorts in the Balearics and Greece to family-friendly all-inclusives in Turkey and long-haul luxury in Mexico, find your perfect break with ABTA/ATOL protection, 20kg luggage allowance, and price-match guarantee.
Summer is calling, and if you haven't yet booked that perfect beach break, there's still time to treat yourself to a fantastic holiday. Opting for a package holiday is one of the best ways to secure great value, with everything wrapped up in a single, easy booking.
TUI has curated an extensive collection of hotels to suit every budget, from luxurious adults‑only swim‑up suites to resorts equipped with splash parks where children can run wild. Imagine a summer where your flights, accommodation, experiences, and transfers are all included, plus a standard 20 kg luggage allowance-making that last‑minute escape both affordable and effortless.
With more than 100 destinations to choose from and departures from over 20 UK airports, you can browse and book with confidence online, via the app, or in a local store. Every package comes with ABTA and ATOL protection to safeguard your money, plus 24/7 support while you're away. TUI also offers a price‑match promise and is rated excellent on Trustpilot, so you can book with peace of mind.
For a classic Mediterranean escape, the Balearic Islands remain a firm favourite. In Mallorca, the TUI BLUE Sensatori Biomar resort in Sa Coma is a short walk from sandy beaches and nature reserves. It features six restaurants offering elevated all‑inclusive dining, endless activities for children, and plenty of luxury for adults seeking relaxation.
Over in Ibiza, the TUI BLUE Tarida Beach sits directly on the shoreline, providing spectacular sunset views, calm waters, and a wide sandy bay backed by pine forest. Its on‑site waterpark is perfect for kids, while both children and teens have their own clubs to enjoy; water sports and poolside sun‑bathing complete the picture. Greece delivers the quintessential Aegean dream, from emerald islands to turquoise waters and whitewashed villages.
On romantic Santorini, the adults‑only TUI BLUE Meltemi on Perissa Beach offers an intimate, boutique experience. Suites with private pools and whirlpools, along with minimalist design, create a sophisticated haven. Enjoy cocktails by the pool, indulgent spa treatments, and fine dining in this grown‑up paradise. For families, Rhodes beckons with the TUI BLUE Atlantica Dreams in the traditional fishing village of Gennadi.
Set right on the pebbly beach, it boasts five pools, a splash park, and dedicated adult‑only zones. With six restaurants, seven bars, and a full programme of sports and activities, there's something for every generation. If you fancy something off the beaten path, Turkey offers unrivalled luxury and value. The TUI BLUE Sensatori Akra Fethiye on the Turkish Aegean coast is surrounded by mountains, palm groves, and stunning beaches.
It's exceptionally family‑friendly, featuring numerous kids' pools, children's buffets, a mini‑disco, and daytime entertainment in a supervised kids' club. A step further afield, Sharm el Sheikh in Egypt brings the allure of the Arabian Nights together with vibrant coral reefs. The TUI Magic Life Redsina is a haven for active holidaymakers, offering diving, snorkelling, and a wide range of water sports, plus fitness classes, golf, tennis, archery, and beach volleyball. Teens, children, and 'big kids' alike will find endless entertainment.
For those dreaming of long‑haul luxury, Mexico provides the ultimate romantic getaway. The TUI BLUE El Dorado Seaside Palms features thatched beach huts and hammocks strung between shady palm trees, creating a tranquil, idyllic setting. It's the perfect place to unwind, soak up the sun, and enjoy exceptional service in a stunning seaside location. Whether you're seeking a family adventure, a couples' retreat, or an adults‑only escape, TUI's range of package holidays ensures a hassle‑free, memorable summer break
